questions.explanation: Savings accounts pay profit on deposits, while current accounts are meant for frequent transactions and pay no profit.
questions.q: Which type of bank account pays profit to the depositor?

questions.explanation: The State Bank of Pakistan is the central bank; it regulates commercial banks and conducts monetary policy.
questions.q: What is the main role of the State Bank of Pakistan?

questions.explanation: A cheque is a written instruction from an account holder ordering the bank to pay a stated sum to the named person.
options: A written order instructing the bank to pay a stated sum

questions.explanation: Term deposits lock the money for a fixed period and therefore offer higher profit than savings accounts.
options: Lower profit than a savings account
No profit is paid at all
Higher profit with money locked for a fixed period
questions.q: How does a term (fixed) deposit differ from a savings account?

questions.explanation: Markup or interest is the price a borrower pays the bank for using its money, i.e., the cost of borrowing.
questions.q: What does markup (interest) on a loan represent?

questions.explanation: ATM stands for Automated Teller Machine, which allows cash withdrawals and other basic services.
A loan default occurs when a borrower fails to repay the loan according to the agreed schedule.
options: Failure to repay a loan on time
questions.q: What is meant by a loan default?

questions.explanation: A debit card spends money from the holder's own account balance, unlike a credit card which borrows from the bank.
options: It borrows money from the bank
It spends from the holder's own account balance
It works without any bank account
questions.q: How does a debit card differ from a credit card?

questions.explanation: KYC stands for Know Your Customer, the process banks use to verify the identity of their customers.
questions.q: What does KYC stand for in banking?

questions.explanation: A demand draft is a payment instrument issued by a bank, guaranteeing payment to the named payee.
